query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_chebi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN smiles IS NOT NULL AND smiles != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_smiles,
  SUM(CASE WHEN xlogp IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_xlogp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN inchi_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_inchi
FROM molecules;
